items.title: A formally catenary Noetherian local ring is universally catenary
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that a formally catenary Noetherian local ring A is universally catenary (source lines 32437-32441). The proof is a chain of reductions followed by a flatness argument. It first replaces A by A/p for a minimal prime p, so that the spectrum of the completion A-hat may be assumed equidimensional; then it reduces the universal catenarity assertion to showing that every local ring essentially of finite type over A is catenary, and further to showing that A[x_1, ..., x_n]_m is catenary for a maximal ideal m lying over the maximal ideal of A (proof lines 32444-32455). The substantive step introduces the unique maximal ideal m' of A-hat[x_1, ..., x_n] lying over m and uses that the displayed map A[x_1, ..., x_n]_m -> A-hat[x_1, ..., x_n]_{m'} is local and flat because completion is flat; it then observes that it suffices to prove the ring on the right is catenary with equidimensional spectrum, which is where formal catenarity enters (proof lines 32456-32463 and following). The non-routine content is the reduction to a single flat local extension of the polynomial ring and the appeal to equidimensionality of the completed spectrum.
